panels.visual: Two little girls of about nine in white robes on the Acropolis near a small house with a view over the city
panels.caption: Every year two girls from noble families were chosen to live on the Acropolis for a year.

panels.visual: The girls helping weave a big saffron robe (the peplos) on a loom, threads and yarn balls, an old priestess watching
panels.caption: The girls helped start weaving the peplos, Athena's new robe.

panels.visual: The two girls at night with closed baskets balanced on their heads, descending a hidden stone passage lit by a tiny lamp
panels.caption: Once a year, at night, they carried closed baskets down a hidden passage.

panels.visual: The girls in a dark garden below the rock, exchanging baskets with a tiny puzzled expression, question marks
panels.caption: They did not know what was inside.
